profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at BAE Systems
profile.summary:
I’m a mathematician and software engineer with a Ph.D. in applied and computational mathematics, passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of math, algorithms, and software. My curiosity drives me to explore new technologies, and I thrive in environments where challenging problems require both deep analysis and innovative engineering.

I bring strong programming expertise and a love for building solutions that are both elegant and practical. Just as importantly, I enjoy mentoring and supporting others — I believe collaboration and knowledge-sharing are some of the best ways we grow as professionals and as people.

Compassionate, hardworking, and always eager to learn, I’m excited about pushing boundaries, embracing new ideas, and contributing to impactful projects that make a difference.
